shortDescription: Manages certificate, key and PKCS12 on the Central Manager.

options.name: cert
options.description: The path to the certificate or PKCS12 file.

options.name: key
options.description: The path to the key file.

options.name: key_passphrase
options.description: The passphrase for the key file.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the key and/or cert combination.

options.name: pkcs12_passphrase
options.description: The passphrase for the PKCS12 cert file. It must be provided when importing a PKCS12 cert.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the key and/or cert is uploaded to the Central Manager. When C(absent), ensures the key and/or cert is removed from the the Central Manager.

options.name: update_cert
options.description: Whether to update the certificate on the Central Manager. Set it to C(yes) when updating an existing certificate. Not required when creating a new certificate.

options.name: update_key
options.description: Whether to update the key on the Central Manager. Set it to C(yes) when updating an existing key. Not required when creating a new key.
